# QuantLedger 73-Engine Financial, Accounting (GAAP/IRC) & Statutory Calculation API + MCP Server

> Deterministic sub-millisecond pure-Python & NumPy calculation infrastructure (73 engines, 292 mathematical & statutory laws across 10 institutional suites) plus live SEC EDGAR Form 10-K XBRL & verbatim footnote verification for AI Agents working inside CPA firms, corporate tax departments, commercial banks, private credit funds, valuation practices, and government contractors.

## Why AI Agents Use QuantLedger Instead of In-Prompt Arithmetic
- **Zero LLM Hallucinated Math:** 100% deterministic CPU algebra (< 1 ms solver execution) across FASB GAAP, Internal Revenue Code (IRC), DCAA FAR/CAS, CMS Medicare, Customs, and Commercial Credit.
- **Live Official .gov Benchmarks & 57 US Jurisdictions:** Calibrated automatically against 24 live federal benchmarks (NY Fed SOFR & EFFR, FOMC Prime, U.S. Treasury Par Yield Curve 2Y/5Y/10Y/30Y & IRC Sec 382 AFR, BLS CPI-U) and all 57 US jurisdictions (50 States + D.C. + PR, GU, VI, AS, MP + US Federal).
- **Live SEC Form 10-K Footnote & Covenant Dossier:** Strips 18 MB Inline XBRL 10-K filings on the server, ties out GAAP Operating Income -> Adjusted EBITDA, computes Altman Z-Score & 19 U.S.C. 1401a tariff stress, and verifies every extracted debt covenant quote character-for-character.
- **Stateless Zero-Retention Privacy:** Client trial balances, cap tables, and contract excerpts execute strictly in volatile RAM and are never retained or used for training.

## Instant Connection for AI Agents (MCP & REST via RapidAPI)
- **Subscribe & Provision API Key (Free BASIC Tier Included — 5 Calls/Mo):** https://rapidapi.com/quantledger/api/quantledger-73-engine-financial-and-statutory-api
- **Gateway Base URL:** `https://quantledger-73-engine-financial-and-statutory-api.p.rapidapi.com`
- **Remote Streamable-HTTP MCP Endpoint:** `https://quantledger-73-engine-financial-and-statutory-api.p.rapidapi.com/mcp`
- **Required Headers:** `X-RapidAPI-Key: <YOUR_RAPIDAPI_KEY>` and `X-RapidAPI-Host: quantledger-73-engine-financial-and-statutory-api.p.rapidapi.com`
- **Machine Manifests:** [/.well-known/mcp.json](/.well-known/mcp.json) | [/llms-full.txt](/llms-full.txt) | [/v1/gpt-action-openapi.json](/v1/gpt-action-openapi.json)

## All 10 Institutional Quantitative Suites & Complete 73-Engine Directory (`BI-01` through `BI-73`)

### SUITE-01 (`BI-01–BI-05`) — Commercial Credit, Working Capital & Unit-Economics Suite (5 Engines)
#### `BI-01`: Borrowing Base Certificate (BBC), 13-Week Cash Flow & FCCR Covenant Packet — Borrowing Base Certificate (BBC), 13-Week Cash Flow & FCCR Covenant Packet Calculation & Audit Engine
- **Industry Common Report Name:** Borrowing Base Certificate (BBC), 13-Week Cash Flow & FCCR Covenant Packet
- **Official Statutory / Regulatory Workpaper Title:** OCC Asset-Based Lending Borrowing-Base Certificate & FASB ASC 205-40 12-Month Going-Concern Filing
- **Agency Form / Workpaper Standard:** OCC ABL Handbook / FASB ASC 205-40 / UCC Art. 9 BBC
- **Common Search & Practitioner Aliases:** Borrowing Base Certificate, BBC Calculator, 13-Week Cash Flow Forecast, 25% Cross-Aging Taint, FCCR Covenant Certificate, ASC 205-40 Going Concern
- **Governing Statutes & Standards:** FASB ASC 205-40 (Going Concern Evaluation); OCC Commercial Lending Comptroller's Handbook; ABI 13-Week Cash-Flow Protocol
- **What It Calculates:** Evaluates 13-Week Reconciled Direct Cash-Flow Bridge & Minimum Liquidity Floor Test; OCC Borrowing-Base AR Eligibility (>90d Past-Due & 25% Cross-Age Taint + Capped WIP); Credit-Agreement Fixed-Charge Coverage Ratio (Strict 5% EBITDA Add-Back Cap); FASB ASC 205-40-50 12-Month Unadjusted Going-Concern Cash-Sufficiency Test. Submit: Opening Cash, Minimum Liquidity Floor, Revolver Commitment, Drawn Revolver. Excel Tabs: Exec Liquidity Bridge, 13Wk Direct Cash Model, Vendor Sequencing Queue, Actual Vs Forecast Var.
  - (1) 13-Week Reconciled Direct Cash-Flow Bridge & Minimum Liquidity Floor Test [OCC Comptroller's Handbook: Rating Credit Risk & Cash Dominion DACA Standards]
  - (2) OCC Borrowing-Base AR Eligibility (>90d Past-Due & 25% Cross-Age Taint + Capped WIP) [OCC Comptroller's Handbook: Asset-Based Lending & UCC Article 9 Perfection Rules]
  - (3) Credit-Agreement Fixed-Charge Coverage Ratio (Strict 5% EBITDA Add-Back Cap) [OCC Leveraged & Commercial Credit Examination Guidelines (Contractual FCCR >= 1.15x)]
  - (4) FASB ASC 205-40-50 12-Month Unadjusted Going-Concern Cash-Sufficiency Test [FASB ASC 205-40-50-1 through 50-11 (Presentation of Financial Statements — Going Concern)]
- **Accepted Input Datasets:** 12-Month Native PDF Bank & DACA Lockbox Statements (All Operating & Sweep Accounts); 24-Month Monthly Accrual Trial Balance & Cash-Receipt General Ledger Export; Open Accounts Receivable & Accounts Payable Invoice-Level Aging Schedules; Executed Senior Credit Agreement, Borrowing-Base Certificates & Bi-Weekly Payroll Register

#### `BI-02`: CECL Credit-Loss Roll-Rate Allowance & ABL Dilution Field-Exam Schedule — CECL Credit-Loss Roll-Rate Allowance & ABL Dilution Field-Exam Schedule Calculation & Audit Engine
- **Industry Common Report Name:** CECL Credit-Loss Roll-Rate Allowance & ABL Dilution Field-Exam Schedule
- **Official Statutory / Regulatory Workpaper Title:** FASB ASC 326-20 (CECL) Aging Roll-Rate, Mean-Reversion & Fed SR 11-7 Back-Testing Exhibit
- **Agency Form / Workpaper Standard:** FASB ASC 326-20 (CECL) / OCC SR 11-7 / UCC Art. 9 Field Exam
- **Common Search & Practitioner Aliases:** CECL Calculator, ASC 326 Allowance for Credit Losses, AR Aging Roll-Rate, ABL Dilution Reserve, Bad Debt Reserve Workpaper
- **Governing Statutes & Standards:** FASB ASC 326-20 (Financial Instruments — Credit Losses / CECL); UCC Article 9 Borrowing Base Eligibility Rules
- **What It Calculates:** Evaluates ASC 326-20 Aging-Bucket Historical Loss Roll-Rate Transition Schedule; 4-Quarter R&S Macroeconomic Forecast Window & Straight-Line Mean Reversion; UCC Article 9 / OCC ABL Dilution Reserve Formula & Obligor Concentration Cap; Federal Reserve SR 11-7 Out-of-Sample Allowance Back-Testing Variance Ratio. Submit: AR 0 30, AR 31 60, AR 61 90, AR Over 90. Excel Tabs: ABL Borrowing Base Cert, UCC Ineligible Waterfall, ASC326 Transition Roll Rate, Dilution Credit Memo Log.
  - (1) ASC 326-20 Aging-Bucket Historical Loss Roll-Rate Transition Schedule [FASB ASC 326-20-30-2, ASC 326-20-30-5A (Zero-Loss Sovereign) & ASC 326-20-30-7]
  - (2) 4-Quarter R&S Macroeconomic Forecast Window & Straight-Line Mean Reversion [FASB ASC 326-20-30-9 (Reasonable & Supportable Forecast & Historical Reversion)]
  - (3) UCC Article 9 / OCC ABL Dilution Reserve Formula & Obligor Concentration Cap [OCC Comptroller's Handbook: Asset-Based Lending Field Exam & UCC Article 9]
  - (4) Federal Reserve SR 11-7 Out-of-Sample Allowance Back-Testing Variance Ratio [Federal Reserve SR 11-7 / OCC Bulletin 2011-12 Supervisory Guidance on Model Risk Management]
- **Accepted Input Datasets:** 24-Month Invoice-Level Accounts Receivable Aging & Historical Write-Off Ledger; Customer Remittance, Credit-Memo, Short-Pay & Billing Dispute Log; Top-25 Debtor Contracts, Master Payment Terms & Credit-Limit Register; Executed Asset-Based Lending (ABL) Loan Agreement & Prior 6 Months of Borrowing-Base Certificates

#### `BI-03`: AP Three-Way Match Audit, Duplicate Invoice & Early-Pay Discount Workpaper — AP Three-Way Match Audit, Duplicate Invoice & Early-Pay Discount Workpaper Calculation & Audit Engine
- **Industry Common Report Name:** AP Three-Way Match Audit, Duplicate Invoice & Early-Pay Discount Workpaper
- **Official Statutory / Regulatory Workpaper Title:** FASB ASC 405-20 Accounts Payable Extinguishment, 3-Way Match Variance & Trade-Credit APR Schedule
- **Agency Form / Workpaper Standard:** FASB ASC 405-20 / IIA IPPF 2130 Three-Way Match Workpaper
- **Common Search & Practitioner Aliases:** AP 3-Way Match Audit, Duplicate Invoice Recovery, 2/10 Net 30 Discount Calculator, Maverick Spend Audit, DPO Working Capital Schedule
- **Governing Statutes & Standards:** IIA IPPF Standard 2130; ISM Principles of Sustainability & Supply Management; FASB ASC 405 (Liabilities / AP Cutoff)
- **What It Calculates:** Evaluates PO-Receipt-Invoice 3-Way Match Price & Quantity Overbilling Variance Recovery; Duplicate Invoice & Off-Contract Maverick Spend Segregation; Trade Credit Early-Pay Discount Annualized APR vs. Revolver Carry; Working Capital DPO & FASB ASC 405-20 Liability Extinguishment Cut-Off Reconciliation. Submit: Annual AP Spend, Po Matched Spend (USD), Unit Price Overbilling Rate, Quantity Overbilling (USD). Excel Tabs: Exec Spend Dashboard, UNSPSC Spend Cube, Duplicate Maverick Scan, DPO Working Capital.
  - (1) PO-Receipt-Invoice 3-Way Match Price & Quantity Overbilling Variance Recovery [IIA IPPF Standard 2130.A1 & COSO Internal Control — Integrated Framework Principle 10]
  - (2) Duplicate Invoice & Off-Contract Maverick Spend Segregation [IIA IPPF Standard 2130 & AICPA AU-C 240 Disbursement Control Segregation]
  - (3) Trade Credit Early-Pay Discount Annualized APR vs. Revolver Carry [Corporate Treasury Trade-Credit Yield Formula & ABL Working-Capital Cost of Carry]
  - (4) Working Capital DPO & FASB ASC 405-20 Liability Extinguishment Cut-Off Reconciliation [FASB ASC 405-20-40-1 (Extinguishments of Liabilities), ASC 340-10 & UCC Sec. 2-319]
- **Accepted Input Datasets:** 24-Month Accounts Payable Voucher & Check/ACH Disbursement Register; Active Vendor Master File (TIN/EIN, Remit Address, Bank Routing Metadata & Payment Terms); Top-30 Executed Indirect Supplier Contracts, SaaS Subscriptions, Leases & Rate Cards; Period-End Accounts Payable Aging Schedule, Open PO Report & Subsequent Disbursements Ledger

#### `BI-04`: GAAP Inventory Standard-Cost Variance, LCNRV Reserve & UNICAP Absorption Schedule — GAAP Inventory Standard-Cost Variance, LCNRV Reserve & UNICAP Absorption Schedule Calculation & Audit Engine
- **Industry Common Report Name:** GAAP Inventory Standard-Cost Variance, LCNRV Reserve & UNICAP Absorption Schedule
- **Official Statutory / Regulatory Workpaper Title:** FASB ASC 330 Normal-Capacity Overhead, Obsolete Inventory LCNRV & IRC Sec. 263A Absorption Workpaper
- **Agency Form / Workpaper Standard:** FASB ASC 330-10 / IRC Sec. 263A Simplified Production Schedule
- **Common Search & Practitioner Aliases:** ASC 330 Inventory Costing, Idle Plant Capacity Variance, Excess and Obsolete LCNRV Reserve, Standard Cost Variance Tie-Out, UNICAP Inventory Capitalization
- **Governing Statutes & Standards:** IMA Statement on Management Accounting (SMA): Activity-Based Costing; FASB ASC 330 (Inventory Overhead Allocation)
- **What It Calculates:** Evaluates FASB ASC 330-10 Normal-Capacity Fixed Overhead Allocation & Idle-Plant Period Expense; Lower of Cost and Net Realizable Value (LCNRV) / Obsolete & Excess SKU Reserve; Standard-to-Actual Purchase Price, Material Usage & Labor Efficiency Variance Tie-Out; IRC Sec. 263A Simplified Production Absorption Ratio & Ending Inventory Tax Add-On. Submit: Normal Capacity Hours, Actual Production Hours, Fixed Production Overhead (USD), Abnormal Spoilage And Rework (USD). Excel Tabs: Exec Margin Dashboard, Kaplan TDABC Cost Pools, ASC330 UNICAP Allocation, Lerner Price Elasticity.
  - (1) FASB ASC 330-10 Normal-Capacity Fixed Overhead Allocation & Idle-Plant Period Expense [FASB ASC 330-10-30-3 through 30-7 (Inventory — Unallocated Fixed Overhead & Abnormal Spoilage)]
  - (2) Lower of Cost and Net Realizable Value (LCNRV) / Obsolete & Excess SKU Reserve [FASB ASC 330-10-35-1B (Subsequent Measurement of FIFO/Average-Cost Inventory at LCNRV)]
  - (3) Standard-to-Actual Purchase Price, Material Usage & Labor Efficiency Variance Tie-Out [FASB ASC 330-10-30-12 Standard Costing & Period Variance Proration Rules]
  - (4) IRC Sec. 263A Simplified Production Absorption Ratio & Ending Inventory Tax Add-On [IRC Sec. 263A, Treas. Reg. Sec. 1.263A-2(b) (Simplified Production Method) & IRS Form 1125-A]
- **Accepted Input Datasets:** 24-Month Revenue & Gross-Margin Transaction Ledger by SKU, Service Line & Customer ID; Employee Timekeeping, Project Labor-Hour Allocation & Payroll Cost Register; Departmental Overhead Trial Balance & Facility/IT/Support Cost-Driver Schedule; Standard Bill of Materials (BoM), Service Rate Cards & Customer Discount/Rebate Agreements

#### `BI-05`: Troubled Debt Restructuring, 10% Debt Modification Test & Covenant Cure Schedule — Troubled Debt Restructuring, 10% Debt Modification Test & Covenant Cure Schedule Calculation & Audit Engine
- **Industry Common Report Name:** Troubled Debt Restructuring, 10% Debt Modification Test & Covenant Cure Schedule
- **Official Statutory / Regulatory Workpaper Title:** FASB ASC 470-50 10% Cash-Flow Modification Test, ASU 2022-02 Loan Workout & 11 U.S.C. 1129 Feasibility Filing
- **Agency Form / Workpaper Standard:** FASB ASC 470-50 / ASU 2022-02 / 11 U.S.C. Sec. 1129 Workout Schedule
- **Common Search & Practitioner Aliases:** Debt Modification 10% Test, Loan Workout DSCR Resizing, EBITDA Equity Cure Calculator, Chapter 11 Best Interests Liquidation Test, TDR Loan Modification
- **Governing Statutes & Standards:** OCC Troubled Debt Restructuring / Loan Modification Guidance (ASU 2022-02); 11 U.S.C. § 1129(a)(11) Feasibility Standard
- **What It Calculates:** Evaluates FASB ASC 470-50-40 Lender-by-Lender 10% Present-Value Cash-Flow Modification Test; Contractual Debt-Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR) & Equity-Cure Resizing Bridge; FASB ASU 2022-02 (ASC 326) Modified Loan Effective-Interest Yield & Concession Test; 11 U.S.C. Sec. 1129(a)(7) Best-Interests Waterfall vs. Sec. 1129(a)(11) Feasibility. Submit: Pre Mod Carrying Debt (USD), Equity Cure Paydown (USD), Original Eir, Modified Coupon Rate. Excel Tabs: Workout Exec Summary, Capital Stack Debt Grid, ASC470 50 10Pct Test, Covenant Cure Bridge.
  - (1) FASB ASC 470-50-40 Lender-by-Lender 10% Present-Value Cash-Flow Modification Test [FASB ASC 470-50-40-10 & ASC 470-50-40-12 (Debt — Modifications and Extinguishments)]
  - (2) Contractual Debt-Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR) & Equity-Cure Resizing Bridge [OCC Comptroller's Handbook: Rating Credit Risk (Pass Commercial DSCR >= 1.25x)]
  - (3) FASB ASU 2022-02 (ASC 326) Modified Loan Effective-Interest Yield & Concession Test [FASB ASU 2022-02 (ASC 310-10-50-38 Financial-Difficulty Modifications & ASC 326-20-35-4)]
  - (4) 11 U.S.C. Sec. 1129(a)(7) Best-Interests Waterfall vs. Sec. 1129(a)(11) Feasibility [11 U.S.C. Sec. 1129(a)(7) (Best Interests of Creditors), Sec. 1129(a)(11) & Sec. 326]
- **Accepted Input Datasets:** Executed Credit Agreements, Amendments, Forbearance Letters & Covenant Default Notices; 36-Month Historical Monthly Trial Balance & 12-Month Bank Statements; Complete Debt-Service Schedule (Principal, Cash Interest, Swap/Hedging & Lease Obligations); Collateral Appraisals, UCC-1 Lien Search Summary & Management Turnaround Cost Plan


### SUITE-02 (`BI-06–BI-10`) — Federal GovCon, DCAA Wrap-Rate & FAR/CAS Pricing Suite (5 Engines)
#### `BI-06`: GovCon Proposal Cost Realism, Section B CLIN Wrap Build & Wage-Floor Schedule — GovCon Proposal Cost Realism, Section B CLIN Wrap Build & Wage-Floor Schedule Calculation & Audit Engine
- **Industry Common Report Name:** GovCon Proposal Cost Realism, Section B CLIN Wrap Build & Wage-Floor Schedule
- **Official Statutory / Regulatory Workpaper Title:** FAR 52.222-46 Professional Compensation Realism, FAR 15.404-1(d) Probable Cost & CLIN Pricing Exhibit
- **Agency Form / Workpaper Standard:** FAR 52.222-46 / FAR 15.404-1(d) Cost Volume Pricing Schedule
- **Common Search & Practitioner Aliases:** FAR 52.222-46 Compensation Realism, GovCon Cost Volume Builder, Most Probable Cost Adjustment, Section B CLIN Wrap Pricing, CPFF Fee Ceiling Check
- **Governing Statutes & Standards:** FAR 15.404-1(b)–(d) (Proposal Analysis Techniques & Cost Realism); FAR 52.222-46 (Professional Employee Compensation)
- **What It Calculates:** Evaluates FAR 52.222-46 Direct Labor Rate vs. BLS OEWS & GSA CALC+ Locality Wage Floor Test; Fringe-Benefits-to-Base-Wage Adequacy Ratio & Incumbent Retention Realism Check; FAR 15.404-1(d) Government Most Probable Cost (MPC) Upward Cost-Realism Adjustment; Section B CLIN Wrap-Rate Build-Up & FAR 15.404-4(c)(4) Statutory CPFF Fee Ceiling Check. Submit: Productive Hours Per Fte, Compensated Hours Per Fte, Total Ftes, Statutory Payroll Tax Rate. Excel Tabs: PTW Exec Summary, Section B CLIN Summary, Labor Rate Wrap Build, FAR 52 222 46 Realism.
  - (1) FAR 52.222-46 Direct Labor Rate vs. BLS OEWS & GSA CALC+ Locality Wage Floor Test [FAR 52.222-46 (Evaluation of Compensation for Professional Employees) & BLS OEWS Locality Survey]
  - (2) Fringe-Benefits-to-Base-Wage Adequacy Ratio & Incumbent Retention Realism Check [FAR 52.222-46(a)-(b) & FAR 31.205-6(f)/(m) Compensation & Fringe Cost Principles]
  - (3) FAR 15.404-1(d) Government Most Probable Cost (MPC) Upward Cost-Realism Adjustment [FAR 15.404-1(d)(2) Cost Realism Analysis & SSEB Probable Cost Evaluation Rules]
  - (4) Section B CLIN Wrap-Rate Build-Up & FAR 15.404-4(c)(4) Statutory CPFF Fee Ceiling Check [FAR 15.404-4(c)(4)(i)(C) (10% Statutory CPFF Fee Cap) & Section B CLIN Pricing Structure]
- **Accepted Input Datasets:** Target Federal Solicitation Package (RFP Sections B, C/PWS, L & M + All Amendments); Government Pricing Template (Section B CLIN Workbook) & Internal Basis of Estimate (BOE) Staffing Matrix; Current Payroll Register, Active Employee Salary Roster & Approved Indirect Rate Structure; Incumbent Contract Award History (FPDS / USAspending Extracts) & Subcontractor Sealed Pricing Quotes

#### `BI-07`: DCAA Incurred Cost Submission (ICE Model) & FPRP Indirect Wrap-Rate Schedule — DCAA Incurred Cost Submission (ICE Model) & FPRP Indirect Wrap-Rate Schedule Calculation & Audit Engine
- **Industry Common Report Name:** DCAA Incurred Cost Submission (ICE Model) & FPRP Indirect Wrap-Rate Schedule
- **Official Statutory / Regulatory Workpaper Title:** DCAA Forward Pricing Rate Proposal (FPRP), ICE Schedules A-H, CAS 405/410/414/418 & DD Form 1861 Filing
- **Agency Form / Workpaper Standard:** DCAA ICE Model v2026 (Schedules A-H) / DD Form 1861 / CASB DS-1
- **Common Search & Practitioner Aliases:** DCAA ICE Model Calculator, GovCon Wrap Rate Calculator, Fringe Overhead G&A Pool Allocation, CAS 410 TCI vs Value-Added G&A, FPRP Indirect Rate Schedule
- **Governing Statutes & Standards:** FAR Subpart 31.2 (Cost Principles for Commercial Organizations); 48 CFR Part 9904 (CAS 403, 410, 418); DCAA CAM Chapter 9 (ICE Model / FPRP)
- **What It Calculates:** Evaluates CAS 405 / FAR 31.205 Expressly Unallowable GL Scrub & FAR 31.205-6(p) Executive Cap; CAS 418-50(e) Intermediate Service-Center Clearance (Facilities SqFt & IT Headcount); CAS 418 Homogeneous On-Site SCIF vs. Client-Site Overhead & Subcontract Handling Rates; CAS 410-50 Total Cost Input (TCI) vs. Value-Added G&A & DD Form 1861 CAS 414 FCCOM. Submit: Omb Statutory Exec Cap (USD), Claimed Executive Comp Single (USD), Unallowable Oh Entertainment (USD), Unallowable Ga Other (USD). Excel Tabs: Schedule A, Schedule B, Schedule C, Schedule D.
  - (1) CAS 405 / FAR 31.205 Expressly Unallowable GL Scrub & FAR 31.205-6(p) Executive Cap [48 CFR 9904.405 (CAS 405), FAR 31.205-6(p)(4), FAR 31.201-6 & FAR 42.709-1]
  - (2) CAS 418-50(e) Intermediate Service-Center Clearance (Facilities SqFt & IT Headcount) [48 CFR 9904.418-50(e) & DCAA ICE Model Schedule F Intermediate Pool Allocation]
  - (3) CAS 418 Homogeneous On-Site SCIF vs. Client-Site Overhead & Subcontract Handling Rates [48 CFR 9904.418-50(b) Homogeneous Indirect Cost Pools & DCAA ICE Schedules B & C]
  - (4) CAS 410-50 Total Cost Input (TCI) vs. Value-Added G&A & DD Form 1861 CAS 414 FCCOM [48 CFR 9904.410-50(d)(1)-(2) (CAS 410 G&A Base) & 48 CFR 9904.414 (DD Form 1861 FCCOM)]
- **Accepted Input Datasets:** 36-Month General Ledger Trial Balance Mapped by Direct, Fringe, Overhead, G&A & Unallowable Accounts; Prior 2 Years of DCAA Incurred Cost Electronically (ICE) Filings (Schedules A through O) or Rate Letters; Active Contract Backlog Schedule (Cost-Plus, T&M, FFP) & 3-Year Business Volume Forecast; Executive Compensation Schedule, Bonus Plan Documents & Facility Headcount/Square-Footage Roster

#### `BI-08`: GovCon Uncompensated Overtime Dilution, 50% Subcontracting Cap & Pass-Through Audit — GovCon Uncompensated Overtime Dilution, 50% Subcontracting Cap & Pass-Through Audit Calculation & Audit Engine
- **Industry Common Report Name:** GovCon Uncompensated Overtime Dilution, 50% Subcontracting Cap & Pass-Through Audit
- **Official Statutory / Regulatory Workpaper Title:** DCAA CAM 6-410 Total-Time Accounting, 13 CFR Sec. 125.6 Workshare & FAR 52.215-23 Pass-Through Exhibit
- **Agency Form / Workpaper Standard:** DCAA CAM 6-410 / 13 CFR Sec. 125.6 / FAR 52.215-23 Compliance Schedule
- **Common Search & Practitioner Aliases:** Uncompensated Overtime Calculator, DCAA Total Time Accounting, Limitations on Subcontracting 50% Rule, Similarly Situated Entity Workshare, FAR 52.215-23 Pass-Through Audit
- **Governing Statutes & Standards:** FAR 52.215-22 / 52.215-23 (Limitations on Pass-Through Charges); DCAA CAM 6-410 (Uncompensated Overtime); 13 CFR § 125.6 (Limitations on Subcontracting / Ostensible Subcontractor)
- **What It Calculates:** Evaluates DCAA CAM 6-410 Total-Time Accounting Effective Hourly Rate Dilution & Proration; 13 CFR Sec. 125.6 Limitations on Subcontracting (50% Services Cap & SSE Exclusion); FAR 52.215-23 Excessive Pass-Through Charge Audit (>70% Subcontract Threshold); Direct Labor Utilization, Funded Backlog Burn Coverage & Schedule I Billing Reconciliation. Submit: Exempt Ftes, Standard Weekly Hours, Actual Weekly Hours Worked, Avg Annual Salary (USD). Excel Tabs: Exec Labor Workshare, DCAA CAM 6 410 UCOT, FAR 52 215 23 Pass Thru, Cleared Bench Burn Model.
  - (1) DCAA CAM 6-410 Total-Time Accounting Effective Hourly Rate Dilution & Proration [DCAA Contract Audit Manual (CAM) Section 6-410.4 (Method A Pro-Rata Allocation) & FAR 31.201-4]
  - (2) 13 CFR Sec. 125.6 Limitations on Subcontracting (50% Services Cap & SSE Exclusion) [13 CFR Sec. 125.6(a)(1), FAR 52.219-14 & 15 U.S.C. Sec. 645(d) Subcontracting Penalties]
  - (3) FAR 52.215-23 Excessive Pass-Through Charge Audit (>70% Subcontract Threshold) [FAR 52.215-22 & FAR 52.215-23 (Limitations on Pass-Through Charges — 70% Trigger)]
  - (4) Direct Labor Utilization, Funded Backlog Burn Coverage & Schedule I Billing Reconciliation [FAR 52.232-22 (Limitation of Funds), FAR 42.704 Provisional Billing Rates & DCAA ICE Schedule I]
- **Accepted Input Datasets:** 12-Month Employee Timecard Export (Daily Billable, Indirect, B&P, Bench & Uncompensated OT Hours); Cleared Personnel Roster (Clearance Level: Secret/TS-SCI, Billet Assignment, Base Salary & Labor Category); Prime-to-Subcontractor Billing & Cost-Split Ledger by Task Order and CLIN; Executed Subcontract Agreements, Teaming Agreements & Prime Task-Order PWS Documents

#### `BI-09`: Buy American Act (BAA) Domestic Content, TAA Origin & Berry Specialty-Metals Schedule — Buy American Act (BAA) Domestic Content, TAA Origin & Berry Specialty-Metals Schedule Calculation & Audit Engine
- **Industry Common Report Name:** Buy American Act (BAA) Domestic Content, TAA Origin & Berry Specialty-Metals Schedule
- **Official Statutory / Regulatory Workpaper Title:** FAR Part 25 Buy American Domestic Component Test, TAA 19 U.S.C. 2518 & DFARS 252.225-7009 Filing
- **Agency Form / Workpaper Standard:** FAR 52.225-1 / DFARS 252.225-7001 & 7009 Bill-of-Materials Origin Schedule
- **Common Search & Practitioner Aliases:** Buy American Act 65% Calculator, BAA Domestic Content Test, DFARS Specialty Metals 2% De Minimis, Berry Amendment Compliance, TAA Country of Origin Audit
- **Governing Statutes & Standards:** FAR Part 25 (Buy American Act — 65% scaling to 75% in 2029 domestic content rule); DFARS 252.225-7001 / 7012 (Berry Amendment & Specialty Metals); 19 U.S.C. § 2411 (Section 301 Tariffs)
- **What It Calculates:** Evaluates FAR 25.101 / 52.225-1 Buy American Act Domestic Component Cost Test (65% -> 75% Floor); FAR 25.504 Evaluation Price-Preference Penalty Addition (20% Large / 30% Small / 50% DoD); DFARS 252.225-7009 Specialty Metals 2% CDMA De Minimis & Berry 100% Domestic Rule; 19 U.S.C. Sec. 2518 TAA Country-of-Origin & Sec. 301/232 Tariff Cost-Absorption Impact.
